hook_title.fr: Elle se dit ruinée pour voir qui l'aime

loop_note: Histoire complète : la dernière image répond à la table vide du plan 6, cette fois pleine de rires.

fr.title: Elle fait semblant d'être ruinée… 💰
fr.description: Mamie Mangue annonce à ses trois petits-enfants qu'elle a tout perdu. Deux disparaissent. Un seul vient chaque soir. Le jour du testament, elle entre… Et toi, tu serais venu ? Voix et images générées par IA.

cast.name: Mamie Mangue
cast.look: a billionaire 80-year-old grandmother whose whole head is a golden red-orange mango with a small stem and a leaf, clever eyes, reading glasses on a golden chain, an elegant cream silk shawl over a plum dress, pearl earrings
cast.voice: a warm clever elderly female voice

cast.name: Citron
cast.look: a 35-year-old businessman whose whole head is a bright yellow lemon, sharp impatient eyes, a slim grey suit, a white shirt without tie, a phone always in his hand
cast.voice: a dry impatient male voice in his thirties

cast.name: Cerise
cast.look: a 28-year-old influencer whose whole head is a glossy dark red cherry with a green stem, oversized white sunglasses, a pink designer jacket, a luxury handbag, holding a phone for selfies
cast.voice: a haughty spoiled young female voice

cast.name: Goyave
cast.look: a 25-year-old nurse whose whole head is a round green guava, kind gentle eyes, light blue hospital scrubs, a worn backpack, modest and warm
cast.voice: a soft kind young male voice

cast.name: Maître Coco
cast.look: a notary whose whole head is a brown hairy coconut, small round glasses, a dark three-piece suit, a leather folder, calm and serious
cast.voice: a deep calm neutral male voice

lines.text: Annoncez à mes petits-enfants que j'ai tout perdu.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Mangue, mischievous, sits across the desk from Maître Coco in a wood-paneled notary office, stacks of files, a green banker's lamp. Medium two-shot, warm light
scenes.motion_prompt: She leans forward and taps the desk with a finger, Maître Coco freezes with his pen. Clock ticking.

scenes.visual_prompt: Maître Coco, surprised, pen suspended above a document, looks over his round glasses at Mamie Mangue. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He slowly lowers his pen and raises his eyebrows. Clock ticking.

lines.text: Elle ira à celui qui m'aimera ruinée.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Mangue, sly smile, adjusts her golden reading glasses in the notary office. Close-up, warm lamp light
scenes.motion_prompt: She smiles and closes her silk shawl around her shoulders. Soft piano.

lines.text: Ruinée ? Alors elle ne vaut plus rien.

scenes.visual_prompt: Citron, cold and dismissive, reads a letter in a grand salon with his phone in the other hand. Medium shot, daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: He crumples the letter and throws it on a table, eyes back on his phone. Phone notification sounds.

lines.text: Moi, je ne rends pas visite aux pauvres.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cerise, haughty, takes a selfie in the same grand salon, sunglasses on her cherry head, the letter at her feet. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: She pouts for her selfie and flicks the letter away with her shoe. Camera shutter sound.

lines.text: Elle doit avoir peur… J'y vais ce soir.

scenes.visual_prompt: Goyave, worried, in his blue nurse scrubs, reads the letter by a hospital window at dusk. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He folds the letter carefully and puts on his backpack. Distant hospital sounds.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Mangue, lonely, sits at a small table with one candle and three empty plates, in a modest little house, rain against the window at night. Wide shot, candle light
scenes.motion_prompt: The candle flickers, she looks at the empty chairs. Sound of rain.

lines.text: Mamie ! J'ai apporté la soupe et tes cachets.

scenes.visual_prompt: Goyave, soaked and smiling, stands in the doorway of the little house at night with a grocery bag and a pill box; Mamie Mangue turns toward him. Medium shot, rain behind him
scenes.motion_prompt: He shakes the rain off and lifts the grocery bag, she stands up surprised. Rain and a door closing.

lines.text: Il est venu tous les soirs. Pendant six mois.

scenes.visual_prompt: Goyave repaints the little kitchen while Mamie Mangue laughs, a warm montage feeling, paint brush, soup on the stove. Medium shot, warm evening light
scenes.motion_prompt: He paints a wall with a roller, she laughs and hands him soup, slow pan. Soft piano.

lines.text: Mamie, arrête de m'appeler pour de l'argent.

scenes.visual_prompt: Citron, annoyed, on the phone at his glass office desk, rolling his eyes. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He hangs up abruptly and throws the phone on the desk. Office noise.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cerise, bored, at a VIP party with neon lights, looks at her phone screen ringing 'Mamie' and swipes it away. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: She rejects the call with one finger and goes back to dancing. Muffled club music.

scenes.visual_prompt: Goyave sleeps on a chair beside a hospital bed at night, holding the hand of Mamie Mangue, who watches him tenderly. Medium shot, soft blue night light
scenes.motion_prompt: She gently squeezes his hand and smiles through tears. Soft beep of a heart monitor.

lines.text: Voici le testament de Madame Mangue.

scenes.visual_prompt: Maître Coco, formal, opens a leather folder at his desk; Citron and Cerise sit in front smirking, Goyave stands at the back of the notary office. Wide shot, warm light
scenes.motion_prompt: He opens the folder and adjusts his glasses, Citron smirks. Paper rustling.

lines.text: Un testament ? Elle n'a plus que des dettes !

scenes.visual_prompt: Citron, mocking, laughs with Cerise in the notary office, arms crossed. Medium two-shot
scenes.motion_prompt: They laugh loudly, Cerise films herself. Laughter.

lines.text: Mes dettes ? Je possède la moitié de cette ville.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Mangue, powerful and elegant, enters the notary office through the double doors, standing straight in her silk shawl, two bodyguards behind her. Low angle, light behind her
scenes.motion_prompt: The doors swing open and she walks in slowly, the camera tilts up. Doors opening, silence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Cerise, panicked, drops her phone, which cracks on the wooden floor of the notary's office during the reading of the will, and forces a big fake smile. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: The phone falls and its screen cracks in slow motion, she forces a smile. Glass crack.

lines.text: Vous avez aimé mon argent. Lui m'a aimée ruinée.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Mangue, tender and firm, places a golden key in the hand of Goyave, who stares in disbelief, in the notary office. Close-up on the hands and faces
scenes.motion_prompt: She closes his fingers over the golden key, he looks up at her. Soft piano rises.

lines.text: Je ne veux pas ton argent, Mamie. Je veux que tu restes.

scenes.visual_prompt: Goyave, crying, hugs Mamie Mangue in the notary office while Citron and Cerise stand frozen in the background. Medium shot, warm light
scenes.motion_prompt: They hug, she pats his back, the camera slowly pulls back. Soft piano.

scenes.visual_prompt: Through a rainy window at night, Mamie Mangue and Goyave laugh together at the same small table, three candles lit and full plates, while Citron and Cerise stand outside in the rain. Wide shot, warm inside, cold blue outside
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow push-in through the window on their laughter, rain streaks on the glass. Rain and muffled laughter.

on_screen_text.fr: On sait qui t'aime quand tu n'as plus rien
